Join us for live coverage of the 2026 Total Solar Eclipse. NSF will be live from the United States of America, the United Kingdom, and Spain, where the moon’s shadow will cross the Arctic and Atlantic Oceans, Iceland, and the Iberian Peninsula on August 12, offering clear views of totality under the summer skies.
